name: Convivial Core
description: Shared functionality for the Convivial profile.
project_description: Convivial Core provides shared base functionality for the Convivial CXP distribution/toolkit by Morpht. On disk it is a very small module: it registers a single admin section landing page at /admin/config/convivial (the 'Convivial CXP' page rendered by Drupal core's SystemController), a matching admin menu link under Configuration, and one access permission ('access convivial administration pages'). It ships no services, no config schema, no controllers of its own, and no external service integrations. It exists so that other Convivial modules have a common admin home and permission to hang their settings on; you normally install it only because another Convivial module depends on it. Maintained by developers at Morpht (morpht.com).
